Why Take Ashwagandha with CBD?

Bringing both powerful herbs together creates a powerful duo that can promote relaxation, stress reduction, improved sleep, and overall well-being. Experience the powerful combination with NextEvo Naturals' CBD products.

What Makes NextEvo Ashwagandha Better?

Our experts work tirelessly to make pure, potent products with high bio-availability.

NextEvo Naturals' Ashwagandha products stand out for their premium quality, rigorous testing, and the synergistic combination of Ashwagandha and water-soluble CBD, providing a powerful blend for optimal relaxation, stress reduction, and overall well-being.

How Much Ashwagandha Should I Take?

When starting a Ashwagandha regimen, a good starting dose is 125mg which is also the recommended dose for our Ashwagandha products. As with any supplement, it's always best to consult with a healthcare professional before starting a new regimen.

settings.title: How to Calibrate Your Ashwagandha Dosage
settings.text_2: Start with 1-6mg for every 10lbs of body weight
settings.text_3: Increase dose incrementally by 5-10mg at a time
settings.text_4: Keep a journal to track your dosage and its effects

Ashwagandha Can Support Your Health Journey

Ashwagandha works best as a supplement to a complete health routine that includes proper sleep, nutrition, and self-care, allowing you to elevate your well-being and embrace a better quality of life.

settings.title: Stress
settings.text:
Ashwagandha is a natural remedy that can help reduce stress by supporting the body's stress response system. It promotes
a sense of calm and relaxation, helping you manage daily stressors more effectively.

settings.title: Reduces Cortisol
settings.text: Ashwagandha has been shown to lower cortisol levels, the hormone that is released in response to stress. By regulating cortisol, it helps restore balance to the body and supports a more relaxed state.

settings.title: Increases DHEA Levels
settings.text:
Ashwagandha has the potential
to increase DHEA (dehydroepiandrosterone) levels in the body. DHEA is a hormone that plays a role in stress management, mood regulation, and overall well-being.

settings.title: Mental Clarity
settings.text:
Ashwagandha has cognitive-enhancing properties that can help improve mental clarity, focus, and concentration. It works to reduce brain fog and optimize brain function for better cognitive
performance.
